title: Original NOAA island habitat candidates
source_validation_note: Original native BAG depth and product-uncertainty screen. Historical hard substrate; no verified catch or charter evidence. Current rules and closure freshness remain required at use/export time.

targets.name: SCI-Q-a1649741dc-B
targets.label: Anacapa Island · surveyed hard-bottom patch
targets.source_name: NOAA H13093: Vicinity of Anacapa Island
targets.terrain_interpretation: Original NOAA multibeam terrain intersects historical mapped hard substrate. Search the supported outline with a sounder; fish and individual boulders are not verified.

rating.score_method: 35×R/(R+12m) + 40×C/(C+2m) + 25×A/(A+5ha); R=p95−p05 relief, C=plane residual RMS, A=qualified hard area within250m

qualification.note: Chart-datum depth screen plus reported product uncertainty and a 2 m planning allowance; not a tide forecast, navigation route or catch probability.

targets.evidence_status: Measured-depth-qualified habitat candidate; no verified catch at this coordinate.
targets.ais_status: No verified charter AIS evidence at this target.
targets.special_note: Historical 2017 survey, not live bathymetry. Variable 1–16 m cells, with only 1–4 m cells eligible here. The survey report identifies dynamic swirling ridges southwest of West Anacapa; terrain relief does not establish bedrock, individual boulders or current catch abundance. The older substrate interpretation is not ground truth. Source product uncertainty is retained without assigning an unsupported confidence interval.
survey_flags: Historical substrate; no field validation at this target
Native bathymetry and product uncertainty, not boulder measurements

recorded_validation.geometry_basis: Entire retained native-cell footprint, then inward erosion and historical hard-substrate intersection. A complete 100 m circle is not claimed.
